notes.title: Version 1.11 Update
notes.content:
Important Update Version 1.11

1.Added automatic controller recognition feature.
Currently supports PS4, Xbox 360, Xbox One.
After game installation, Steam Input is set to disabled by default. If it is enabled, please disable it.
otherwise, the automatic recognition will only display "UNKNOWN."

Upon entering the game, choose between "Auto" mode and "Custom" mode.
In Auto mode, the game will automatically detect the controller type, while in Custom mode, players have the option to manually configure the controller buttons.


2.Press the R1 button to enter fullscreen mode and the L1 button to exit fullscreen mode.

 [img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44257788/61b73e2f696176be5ecb5bf5eb35971d344654fa.png[/img]


If your Steam Input is enabled and you need to disable it, please follow the steps below:

Disable Steam Input
First, ensure that the client is in Big Picture Mode. Click on the "Settings" button to bring up the menu, then select the "Properties" option.
On the Properties page, choose "Controller" on the left side. On the right side, select either "Use default settings" or "Disable Steam Input."

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44257788/6789c88c83b752ff5190bab0277afc701d551410.png[/img]
